## Summary

What changed and why?

## Scope

Changed surfaces and relevant boundaries.

## Validation

Commands actually run, results, and unavailable/omitted checks with reasons.

## Risk and rollback

Material risks and the concrete way to recover.

## Deploy status

Publication or deployment is a separate authorized operation.

## Documentation

Affected operational documentation updated, or why no update was needed.
